##: Installer Type: Electron Builder NSIS package with a nested app-64.7z payload
description: Real-time voice, text, and screen translation for Windows.
pre_install: if (-not (Test-Path -LiteralPath $nestedArchive -PathType Leaf)) { throw 'The Whispra application archive was not found in the downloaded installer.' }
notes: Whispra requires signing in with a Whispra account. Supports Windows 10/11 64-bit. Cloud translation and ElevenLabs text-to-speech require network access; virtual microphone workflows may require a separately installed virtual audio device. Scoop extracts the nested application payload and does not run the vendor setup or register its uninstaller.
